tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Raw Paper by day (readable in sun), Carbon at night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, sheets, inputs on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track and recessed wells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons. 13.8:1 on paper, 16.4:1 on surface by day; 12.1:1 on surface at night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, labels, dates. 6.7:1 on paper, 8.0:1 on surface by day; 8.0:1 on surface at night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the Unknown pill and input borders (3.1:1 on surface by day, 4.6:1 at night).

tokens.name: signal-pink
tokens.usage: THE one action per screen (Log visit, Save visit, Research), the mark's line, the Find-out-first shadow. Carbon text on it: 4.9:1. Never a status, never a link.

tokens.name: signal-pink-print
tokens.usage: Print and merchandise only. Carbon text on it is 3.96:1, so it never fills a button on screen.

tokens.name: pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink as text: the Find-out-first label and the rep's handwritten notes. 5.5:1 on paper by day, 7.3:1 on paper at night.

tokens.name: citron
tokens.usage: The point: the citron dot in the brain mark (the brains of the operation, found) and tags for this stop's open question (Verify occupant). Carbon text only (12.9:1). Never text on paper.

tokens.name: iron-oxide
tokens.usage: Fill for Conflict, Don't contact and overdue tags, with white text (4.9:1).

tokens.name: iron-oxide-text
tokens.usage: Iron Oxide as text on paper or surface (6.3:1 by day, 7.3:1 at night).

tokens.name: aluminum
tokens.usage: Neutral info tag fill (Return Nov 15, MIMO) with Carbon text (9.2:1).

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Fixed dark: app icon tile, the ring around the citron point, the Done/Enrolled tag, selected segment by day.

tokens.name: raw-paper
tokens.usage: Fixed light: text on Carbon fills, the selected segment by night.
